programme.desc: The Pina Colada Episode: Murray and Geoff try to pull Beverly, Barry and Erica out of their shared misery after Lainey's departure. Coach Nick returns to town.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: I Coulda Been a Lawyer: Beverly campaigns for a new stop sign on the street. Barry panics about his college applications, and Murray's attempt to help makes things worse.

programme.title: Lego Masters Australia
programme.desc: Brand new series - Lego Go Go Go Karts: We're off to a flying start as four teams of four build Lego go karts, and take to the track for an exhilarating race to the finish.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Chappy's: Gordon visits Chappy's in Tennessee, where the chef and owner's careless methods and less-than-appetising food have hurt his restaurant's local reputation.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
programme.desc: Amy's Baking Company: At Amy's Baking Company in Scottsdale, Arizona, Gordon Ramsay meets a husband and wife team with a shocking contempt for customer feedback.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
programme.desc: (2022) More madcap monster-based animated escapades, with Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez's voices. Ever wondered what an ancient vampire would look like if he were human? Wonder no more.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Jiminy Conjecture: Leonard and Penny feel awkward around each other after their romantic liaison, while Sheldon and Howard take bets to determine a species of cricket.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Gothowitz Deviation: Sheldon tries to modify Penny's behaviour, and rewards her with chocolate when she does what he wants, while Howard and Raj go to a goth nightclub.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Pirate Solution: Raj must find a job or he'll be sent back to India, so he accepts an offer of work from Sheldon. Leonard and Penny try to get some time for themselves.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: 'Scuse Me While I Miss the Sky: Lisa petitions Mayor Quimby to end Springfield's light pollution problem, which leads to unexpected problems...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Three Gays of the Condo: After realising that Marge only married him because she was pregnant with Bart, Homer moves out and ends up sharing an apartment with two gay men.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Whistler's Father: Maggie reveals a hidden talent, which Grampa tries to exploit. Marge gets a job as a decorator for the mob.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Grampy Can Ya Hear Me: Grampa's new hearing aid tells him more about the world than he wants to know. Skinner learns that his mother shattered his boyhood dream.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mr. Lisa's Opus: In her Harvard application, 18-year-old Lisa recounts the story of her childhood - including the time when Marge planned to leave Homer...

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Gone Boy: Bart falls into an old top-secret underground military installation in the woods.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Haw-Haw Land: Nelson goes all-out to impress Lisa when she falls for the talented new boy at school. And Bart takes up chemistry - but to what end?

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
programme.desc: (2019) Adventure comedy sequel with Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart and Karen Gillan. The old school pals enter the Jumanji video game again to save their friend.

programme.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
